items.title: EU reportedly fails to reach agreement on additional Ukraine financing
items.summary: A Russian commentary report says EU leaders failed to agree on a proposed €45 billion loan for Ukraine for 2027, citing opposition from Hungary, Slovakia and Czechia. Further discussions are reportedly expected on December 17–18.

items.title: Czechia reportedly proposes tighter eligibility rules for Ukrainian refugee assistance
items.summary: Proposed legislation would require employable Ukrainian assistance recipients to work, operate a business or register with employment services. Czech Interior Minister Lubomír Metnar reportedly said the changes were intended to prevent abuse of the benefits system.

items.title: NATO reconnaissance flight reported near Kaliningrad
items.summary: An air traffic control source cited by Russian state media said a NATO reconnaissance aircraft spent nearly five hours near Russia's Kaliningrad region. NATO has not independently confirmed the report in the available material.
